| backend/app/orchestrator/simulation_orchestrator.py | 425 | Synchronous method `run_simulation` calls async method `_save_progress` without await. | backend/app/api/endpoints/abilities.py | 36 | Name collision: `AbilityStatus` Pydantic model shadows `AbilityStatus` imported from `app.rpg.abilities` (Line 15). | Rename the Pydantic model to `AbilityStatusResponse`.<br><br>```python<br>class AbilityStatusResponse(BaseModel):<br>    # ... fields ...<br><br># Update usages in router decorators:<br>@router.get(..., response_model=Dict[str, AbilityStatusResponse])<br>``` |
